verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Auth0's core identity platform source being published under an open license. The GitHub-hosted MCP server and CLI, and community praise for Auth0's "open source packages", concern peripheral tooling with no license stated, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. One commenter contrasts Auth0 with wanting to "build on open-source", which suggests the core is proprietary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
